card.fires_on: The middle or end piece of a person's name split into parts, such as Ha-ick, Lar-issa, Ja-ume, Bir-ck. Seen mostly where a researcher or reviewer is named.

modes.label: Researcher surname
modes.description: Final piece of a rare surname for a scientist quoted in an article.

modes.label: First name piece
modes.description: The later part of a first name before the surname, in bylines or credits.

modes.label: Other name pieces
modes.description: Middle of a less common name or a name-like word.
modes.example: Ja<<ume>> Sabartés, a poet turned journalist
